description:
Self-onboarding & capacity top-ups for Agent Sentinel (`pack: 'sentinel'`, $39/mo · 10 Armed Watches + 250 Hashes/mo via Stripe), the Agent Sentinel +11 Watch Top-Up (`pack: 'watch_11'`, $39/mo · expands a Sentinel key from 10 → 21 Watches max via Stripe), Sovereign Command (`pack: 'enterprise'`, $399/mo · 64 Armed Watches + 5,000 Priority Hashes/mo via Stripe), & One-Time Zero-Rotation Hash Top-Ups (`pack: 'credits_250'` $25 / +250 Hashes, `pack: 'standard'` $50 / +500 Hashes via Bitcoin Lightning, USDC, OR Stripe Card Checkout) (`POST /v1/agent/invoice` & `POST /v1/agent/claim`). IMPORTANT:
1. Before calling `create_invoice`, ask the user which tier/pack they want:
   - **Agent Sentinel (`pack: 'sentinel'`, $39/mo · 10 Armed Watches + 250 Hashes — `payment_method: 'stripe'`):** 24/7 AI Agent Memory & Config Monitoring · 1 Workstation (expandable once via `pack: 'watch_11'` +11 Watches for $39/mo up to a 21-Watch cap) · Hourly Bitcoin Batch Bus · Full MCP & Desktop Sentinel.
   - **Sovereign Command (`pack: 'enterprise'`, $399/mo · 64 Armed Watches + 5,000 Priority Hashes — `payment_method: 'stripe'`):** Priority 10-Minute Bitcoin Superhighway · Multi-Host Cloud & Server Fleet · External SIEM & Dead Man's Switch Webhooks.
   - **Zero-Rotation Capacity Top-Up (`pack: 'credits_250'` $25 / +250 Hashes or `pack: 'standard'` $50 / +500 Hashes — `lightning`, `usdc`, or `stripe`):** One-time Hash Credit reload directly onto an existing API key with zero key rotation.
2. When `create_invoice` returns:
   - For **Lightning**: ALWAYS present BOTH the scannable QR code image (by calling Read on `qr_code_png_path`) AND the full, un-truncated `ln_invoice` (`bolt11`) string in a copyable code block on the VERY FIRST try!
   - For **Stripe**: The Stripe Checkout page opens automatically in the user's browser; also present the clickable `checkout_url` link and QR code (`qr_code_png_path`). Once paid, call `claim_invoice` with `invoice_id` (`cs_...`) to activate and save the key.

action.description: 'create_invoice' generates a Lightning BOLT11 invoice, USDC PaymentIntent, or Stripe Checkout Session; 'claim_invoice' exchanges a paid Lightning invoice_id or Stripe session_id ('cs_...') for a new API key or reloads/upgrades an existing API key.

api_key.description: Optional: pass an existing `rel_key_...` key (or omit to use RELTIME_API_KEY if reload_existing is true) to reload or upgrade that key without rotating it.

invoice_id.description: Required when action is 'claim_invoice'. Pass either the Strike Lightning `invoice_id` UUID or the Stripe Checkout `session_id` (`cs_...`).

pack.description: REQUIRED for 'create_invoice'. Pass 'sentinel' for Agent Sentinel ($39/mo · 10 Watches + 250 Hashes), 'watch_11' (+11 Sentinel Watches for $39/mo · 1 max per key up to 21 cap), 'enterprise' for Sovereign Command ($399/mo · 64 Watches + 5,000 Priority Hashes), 'credits_250' ($25 / +250 Hashes), or 'standard' ($50 / +500 Hashes).

payment_method.description: REQUIRED for 'create_invoice' after asking the user. Payment method: 'lightning' (Bitcoin Lightning BOLT11 invoice + QR code), 'usdc' (USDC Machine Payment), or 'stripe' (Stripe Card Checkout URL + browser launch). Never guess — if omitted on 'create_invoice', returns the tier/payment prompt so you can ask the user.

reload_existing.description: If true, reloads Hash Credits or upgrades tier directly on the currently configured RELTIME_API_KEY (or passed `api_key`) instead of generating a new key.

name: reltime_provision_agent_key
